purpose: Sealed machine-precondition architecture for a future one-shot candidate-only Hosea rematerialization; it cannot authenticate the owner or authorize an effect.

component_boundaries.provider_neutral_policy: Pure closed-schema validation and deterministic relationship derivation; no host, filesystem, clock-read, process, authorization, or publication effects.
component_boundaries.windows_production_adapter: No injectable provider, clock, physical path, role, path token, parent ID, process classification, or authorization input; exact task allowlists are resolved under retained Windows handles.
component_boundaries.test_adapter: Separate entry point and provenance that can never satisfy the production policy.
component_boundaries.future_wrapper: Must pin the final component-freeze hash, obtain external owner capability outside local JSON, retain the in-process lease, and bind prepare/publish/recovery receipts.
component_boundaries.human_gate: Outside the machine policy. Local files can describe an observed user message but cannot prove identity or independently satisfy authorization.

fixed_allowlists.targets: Exactly 13 code-fixed target IDs, roles, model-relative normalized path tokens, parent tokens, leaf names, preimage hashes, and staged hashes.
fixed_allowlists.sentinels: Exactly three code-fixed global-sidecar IDs, roles, model-relative normalized path tokens, parent tokens, leaf names, and expected hashes.
fixed_allowlists.process_names: One exact code-defined normalized bounded-name tuple; callers cannot add, remove, classify, or exempt rows.
